data.what_it_does: Decodes Brotli compressed data into bytes or strings. Supports web, mobile, desktop and server platforms.
use_when: Decoding Brotli compressed assets bundled with the app
Processing Brotli compressed files on the device
avoid_when: You need to encode data to Brotli
You require a native encoder for performance
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies
Simple API with decodeToString and stream support
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to full Brotli libraries
data.setup_notes: Add brotli: ^0.6.0 to pubspec and import package:brotli/brotli.dart
